phase: pre-outcome metadata review; not the final cohort/binding gate

endpoint.units: Published main-panel DESeq2 Alt-versus-Ref by RNA-versus-DNA interaction in delta log2 fold-change units after source summit-shift normalization.
endpoint.positive_direction: Alternative construct has greater RNA-relative-to-DNA activity than reference construct, as defined in the article Methods.
endpoint.DNA_orientation_evidence: S2 SNV allele1/allele2 bases match the exact Variant ID Ref/Alt at insert index99; full reference insert validates against hg38 after the hg19 chain mapping.
endpoint.not_equal_to: Raw read counts, absolute transcripts, endogenous gene expression, a literal difference of the earlier Agarwal aggregate estimates, S7 shrunken multi-cell effects, satmut posterior effects, or a meta-analysis.

source_processing.evidence_section: MPRA data processing and main analysis
source_processing.quoted_QC: Variants with fewer than 30 DNA counts or with exactly 0 RNA counts in oligonucleotides for either allele were excluded from all downstream analysis.
source_processing.quoted_duplicate_library_rule: When variants were assayed in multiple libraries, the library with the highest sum of the square roots of plasmid counts in reference and alternative sequences was selected.
source_processing.quoted_S4_rule: In Supplementary Table 4, we report the best measurement across libraries (by plasmid coverage across variants) chosen per variant per cell type.
source_processing.observed_ID_metadata: S4 has304278 data rows,304278 unique IDs and no duplicate/blank IDs; all IDs occur in S2.
source_processing.application: Use the authoritative published preprocessed S4 table unchanged. No library choice by reporter effect, no new activity/FDR/PIP threshold, no inferred unobserved count or reapplication of a guessed threshold to rounded aggregate counts.
source_processing.limit: This source-level documentation and ID uniqueness do not independently audit raw count filtering or recover the discarded library alternatives. S4 does not retain per-library IDs, source classes or an explicit final-workbook missing-token convention.

source_class_metadata.source: Official S30.MPRA Controls design sheet, columns ID/Control Type/Source/Libraries/Sequence
source_class_metadata.application: Every component containing a reused technical-control match must be excluded after full external population unions. Genuine newly measured location/annotation/null controls remain eligible under the frozen contract; no source effect or significance category selects the cohort.

remaining_gates: Complete frozen transitive component and previous-source homology checks on all reference-validated external pairs before any component exclusion.
Commit the exact source/header/cohort/model binding before numeric effect parsing.
Verify ordinary finite numeric type and exact target ID/context coverage under the frozen no-accepted-token policy; preserve and stop on any unexplained cell.
